paths.@tanstack/react-form: @chelone/core wraps @tanstack/form-core directly; the React bridge lives in @chelone/react (and never uses react-form — its useForm cannot accept an external FormApi).
paths.@tanstack/react-store: @chelone/core is vanilla TS — the react-store uSES bridge belongs in @chelone/react.
paths.react: @chelone/core is vanilla TS — no React. Put React code in @chelone/react.
paths.react-router: @chelone/core must not own a router; use the RouterProvider interface.
